permissionMode.description: Default permission behavior for tool execution.

permissionAllow.description: Legacy allow rules in <tool:match> format. Migrated into policy v2 at runtime.

permissionDeny.description: Legacy deny rules in <tool:match> format. Migrated into policy v2 at runtime.

extensionToolEnforcement.description: Require requiredPermission metadata for extension tools in auto mode.

enabled.description: Enable Linux bubblewrap sandbox for process-based tools.

showImages.description: Render images inline when the terminal supports it.

clearOnShrink.description: Clear trailing rows when content shrinks to avoid stale artifacts.

compactFooter.description: Use a compact single-line footer layout.

enabled.description: Enable built-in web search tool integration.

providerMode.description: Primary web search provider selection strategy.

fallbackMode.description: Fallback provider policy when primary lookup fails.

botToken.description: Telegram bot token for Bot API access.

allowedUserIds.description: Allowlist of Telegram user IDs permitted to control the bridge (non-numeric values are ignored at runtime).

statusEditThrottleMs.description: Minimum milliseconds between live status edits in Telegram.

maxSummaryChars.description: Max characters in final chat summary before attaching full output as a file.

pollingTrace.description: Enable verbose polling/update tracing in terminal logs for Telegram bridge.
